svg.title: MarbleNet speech probability with onset and offset thresholds
svg.desc: Frame-level speech probability from NeMo MarbleNet every 10 ms for the first 60 seconds of the public VoxConverse clip aepyx. A segment starts when the probability rises above the onset threshold 0.9 and ends when it falls below the offset threshold 0.5. Below, the detected speech segments are compared with the human-labelled speech.
svg.text: Voice activity detection: speech probability every 10 ms
Public VoxConverse clip aepyx. Shaded: human-labelled speech. Thresholds from the NeMo meeting preset; min-duration filters not applied here.
